name: Grave-Sweeping Chant (Tảo Mộ Ca)
notes: Depth lineage specifies names: [] (element-free), given temporary lint proxy ["thuy"] for lint_techniques.py until body-element-free-names allows names: [] for R3 no-lean sects; Sweep the Stones is element-free. Passives sized to tier 0 (8 W) as unpriced proposal.
concept: The outer gate's method: sweeping the graves of Lôi Trạch and training the ear of the soul without drawing an element.
lore: Lý Hận Bích set it down in 961 from the chant the cave hunters of Thủ Động Trại sang when they swept Khải Lôi's dead on Kinh Trập (V152).

name: Canon of the Autumn Graves (Thu Phần Kinh)
notes: Depth lineage specifies names: [] (element-free), given temporary lint proxy ["thuy"] until body-element-free-names lands. Depth passive x_soul had scope ["song"], widened to [] because x_soul applies to all soul hits and "song" is not in Modifier TIER (b2). Bonus (than_thuc_pct 10) and two additional passives sized to tier 1 (16 W).
concept: To sing with the dead: raises a chorus that gains voices as the fight grows deadly and strikes the soul.
lore: Written by Lý Hận Bích between 960 and 1000 at the graves (C197). The Pavilion holds she did not write it, only heard it.

name: Ward of the Jade of Resentment (Hận Bích Trận)
notes: Depth lineage specifies names: [] (element-free), given temporary lint proxy ["thuy"] until body-element-free-names lands. Bonuses and passives newly sized to tier 2 (24 W).
concept: The founder's grave ward: holds resentment in the earth with seals and long curses that harden into grave jade.
lore: Taught only to the head and her elders. Lý Hận Bích laid the first ward in 960; Lương Thanh Mộ entered the deepest grave in 1110 to renew it from inside.
